_about: laneCHASE v1: a monster that is engaged follows the player (also through a gate) and gives up when the player gets far enough away. Dark: enabled=false = zones behave as laneZONES shipped (leash teleport, no follow). Needs zones.json enabled too. Every number here is read by ChaseAgent / ChaseCore, none is in code. Rows by roster id; '*' is the row for any creature without its own. RECOMMENDATION to Dom, not his decision yet: chase speed 5 to 10 percent under the player's run speed (0.92 = 8 percent under), so a sprint escapes slowly and a walk does not.

rows._speedMul_about: chase speed = this x the player's CURRENT run speed (player.runSpeed x exhausted/wound/stance multiplier). Never above it, so the player can always outrun it; tune 0.90 to 0.95.
rows._gap_about: metres between bodies. Beyond startGap the chase agent drives the body (AI paused: no swing, no decision). Back inside stopGap the AI takes over again (hysteresis, no flicker).
rows._slow_about: the last metres before stopGap the speed ramps down to 0 so control hands back without a pop
rows._giveUp_about: gives up when the gap passes giveUpGap, OR the gap stayed above outOfReachGap for giveUpOutOfReachS seconds in a row, OR the creature is further than its spawn row's leash from home
rows._reset_about: true = full hp when it arrives home (the old leash rule). It does not re-aggro while walking home.
rows._follow_about: followThroughGate true: the creature comes through an open gate you take while it is within followGateMaxGap; it appears followArriveBehindM behind you under the flash and keeps chasing. A creature that cannot follow (false, or too far) keeps the gate shut while it is engaged, as laneZONES shipped.
rows._anim_about: run clip plays when speed >= runClipFromMps, walk clip when <= walkClipBelowMps (gap between = hysteresis, no clip flip-flop). Animator speed = speed / the creature's own nominal run (or walk) speed, clamped animMin..animMax, so the legs follow the body at the speed limit.

rows._note: Dom: he follows through the gate
